name: io.github.Servosity/connectwise-manage-mcp
title: ConnectWise Manage MCP
description: Every ConnectWise PSA workflow from the terminal  -  with a typed conditions query builder, offline

environmentVariables.name: CONNECTWISE_MANAGE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the ConnectWise PSA API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: CW_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Pins the ConnectWise Manage API version sent on each request, e.g. 2025.1. Leave blank to use the version your instance defaults to.

environmentVariables.name: CW_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the CW_CLIENT_ID credential for the ConnectWise Manage MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: CW_COMPANY_ID
environmentVariables.description: ConnectWise Manage company ID/codebase used in the composite Basic auth username.

environmentVariables.name: CW_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API Member private key used as the composite Basic auth password.

environmentVariables.name: CW_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API Member public key used with the company ID in the composite Basic auth username.

environmentVariables.name: CW_SITE
environmentVariables.description: ConnectWise Manage region host such as api-na.myconnectwise.net, api-eu.myconnectwise.net, api-au.myconnectwise.net, or your on-prem host.
